decision_rule.text: Report all paired integer differences. Claim C-count only if candidate field_products is strictly smaller on all8 targets, answers verify, and baseline/aa exact counters agree. Otherwise report mixed/no reduction or invalid panel.

decision_rule.interval: Exact fixed-fixture values; no confidence interval
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: Absolute event differences and explicitly derived ratios
